label: Human Input
description: Pauses the workflow for a human to approve/reject or modify content. Tasks are assigned to a user or a role and route down handles based on the human decision.

config.name: inputType
config.description: Approval gate or content modification task.

config.name: assignmentType
config.description: Assign the task to a specific user or a role.

config.name: content
config.description: Content presented to the human to review/modify.

produces.reference: connect edges with sourceHandle matching the decision handle
produces.note: Approval type routes via approve/reject; modification type routes via modify/revert. Connect the handle(s) your flow needs and forward the reviewed content downstream.
